[[Flint's Artifact]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Flint Fleshcleaver]], a [[boss]] who can be found in Grenth's Footprint.

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Water Magic]])
:[[Water Magic]] +1 (20% chance while using [[skill]]s)
:Halves skill recharge of [[Water Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as a [[Frost Artifact]] [[dye]]d blue.

==Replica==
It is not possible to replicate this item, as it effectively has two [[inscription]]s, "Master of My Domain" and "Forget me Not".
